encoder_cross_check.definition: spikeenc.encoders.TTFS at the base e_frac against this script's independent simulation of the same SPEC 4.7 rule, on the same drive

diagnostics.gate_definition: gate = e_frac * E_max, E_max the largest frame energy over all channels and all frames; gate_log10_ratio_to_quietest_frame is log10(min frame energy / gate), so a negative value means the gate sits above the quietest frame and therefore gates something
diagnostics.note: the relative gate is scale-free, so unlike the absolute e_min of the superseded e6_rate_parameter_span run it cannot drift below the signal when the corpus changes

scale_invariance.definition: the drive is multiplied by each scale and the full rule re-run; energy scales as the square of amplitude, so the two decade figures differ by a factor of two by construction
